behavior: Scan actively refreshes enabled stable adapters with WlanScan using actual interface GUIDs; bounded four-second wait before netsh cached results read
Join skips disabled/transitional and target-invisible adapters
Prefers an unused adapter over disrupting an existing network, then strongest target signal
Already-associated target returns without profile rewrite or Connect
Connection completion reads WlanQueryInterface current connection on exactly chosen GUID
Only one Connect attempt; no adapter-hopping or speculative state-changing retry
Native allocations and handle released on success/failure
Profile secrets remain native memory/Windows storage; no temporary file or shell secrets
limitations: No actual radio association or native OS DLL invoked by worker; parent owns real validation
Scan waits up to driver documented four-second window rather than notification registration; scan completion beyond that may require another explicit Scan
Native WLAN location permission failures are reported; no fallback to stale cached scan after all requests fail
